MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next purchase because it adds door monitoring alongside my Alexa devices and earlier door alarm, giving me a capability my recent purchases do not already cover.",
    "The Alexa displays and Mac-compatible keyboard reflect real interests in my history: connected home devices and practical computer accessories. Their features appeal even though I would not buy them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV sticks and older Echo Dot duplicate needs covered by my recent 4K Max bundle and fourth-generation Dot; sharing the same purpose does not make them useful next purchases.",
    "The additional Echo displays and compact keyboard arrive too soon after my Show 5 and full-size Bluetooth keyboard purchases. The compact keyboard also lacks the numeric keypad I recently chose.",
    "The earbuds and headphone adapter do not address a need I have identified. Buying Mac-compatible accessories does not mean I currently want personal audio products or have a device that needs that adapter."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated Alexa purchases seem to be treated as interest in any Alexa device, including older versions and products that repeat functions I already have.",
    "My computer-accessory purchases seem to be stretched into a broad interest in Bluetooth and Apple-related products, without enough attention to what each accessory would actually help me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter: a new display, streaming bundle, and keyboard reduce my immediate need for another item serving the same purpose.",
    "My history includes accessories that support equipment I already use, such as the Show 5 stand and Harmony replacement batteries. Compatibility and a concrete supporting role can matter more to me than another main device.",
    "A useful addition to my setup, such as door monitoring, gives me a clearer reason to buy than an older generation, a themed cover, or a different size of something I just purchased."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa devices and computer accessories, but miss how recent purchases shift my next need toward useful additions rather than duplicate devices."
}
